opportunities.title: PHP2Shell Week in Review: From Disclosure to Mirai Botnets to 'No Emergency Fix' for Bug #3
opportunities.why_now: PHP2Shell has dominated five straight days of coverage — disclosure, UK government outages, pre-disclosure AWS attacks, Mirai adoption, and now a third unpatched variant — making it the defining breach-cycle story of the week.
opportunities.angle: Running digest/timeline format tracking escalation, with a 'patch status' table readers can bookmark and refresh

opportunities.title: China's AI Pentest Tool 'Artex' Helped Storm-0940 Walk Into 2,250 Cloud Tenants via ConnectWise
opportunities.why_now: Microsoft just confirmed the attribution and scale of the ConnectWise supply-chain breach, and SecurityWeek separately reports the attackers used an AI pentesting tool — a concrete, newsworthy fusion of supply-chain and AI-threat-actor angles.
opportunities.angle: Explainer connecting the dots: ConnectWise compromise → Storm-0940 attribution → Artex AI tooling → 2,250 tenant blast radius

opportunities.title: Arista VeloCloud's Zero-Day Hat Trick: Three Exploited Flaws in Four Months
opportunities.why_now: CISA just flagged active exploitation of a third VCO zero-day in as many months, turning a single-vendor pattern into a repeat-offender story worth tracking.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition piece on recurring zero-days in one product line, with a 'what changed each time' breakdown

opportunities.title: GitLab's 12-Year-Old RCE Bug Just Surfaced — And the Fix Traces Back to Ruby's Regex Engine
opportunities.why_now: A max-severity GitLab RCE spanning over a decade of releases, now tied to three newly-patched Ruby regex bugs, is a rare 'root cause' story worth unpacking before mass exploitation starts.
opportunities.angle: Technical breakdown of how a language-level regex flaw cascaded into a dozen years of vulnerable GitLab releases, plus a patch-now checklist

opportunities.title: One Brotli Bug, Four Languages: The Decoder Flaw Hiding in Node, Bun, and Python
opportunities.why_now: The Hacker News just revealed the Node.js Brotli RCE also hits Bun and Python, exposing how a single compression library bug can ripple across unrelated runtimes — a textbook inevitable-breach supply-chain story.
opportunities.angle: Cross-ecosystem impact map: which runtimes/frameworks ship the vulnerable decoder and what to patch first
